observations.epoch_band_state_and_other_notes: Converted from combined_mcv_sources.csv. X-ray flux from Ridder+23 Table 3. Updated audit: preferred Gaia DR3/Bailer-Jones geometric posterior 160.257 (+3.850/-3.518) pc; historic Thorstensen+03 163(+66/-50) pc and 113(+19/-16) prior alternative preserved in ledger. Orbital period is 0.05626586 d from Bailey+82; Howell+06 quotes an uncertainty ten times larger than Bailey/Khangale. Ridder+23 1–10 keV value is compiled with unresolved derivation; low-state XMM 0.1–10 keV remains 6.0e-14. 2023 high-state X-ray and 2017/2025 radio measurements are separately recorded by epoch/state.

issues.competing_evidence: Filor+25 arXiv v2 body gives model range 0.55–0.63 Msun; journal abstract gives 0.55–0.58. Schwope & Christensen+10 has conditional Mwd>0.65 Msun at 3sigma; older 0.82–1.00 values are historical X-ray models.
issues.why_it_matters: WD mass affects donor mass, q, radii and evolutionary interpretation; model and conditional optical constraints do not agree straightforwardly.
issues.needed_action: Retrieve/confirm final ApJ full-text Table 3 and reconcile abstract with arXiv v2; compare X-Shooter irradiated-line correction and donor-track assumptions before promoting one mass. Keep alternatives separate meanwhile.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

issues.competing_evidence: Optical limit >M9; K-band water index M6 or L4–5, favor L4–5 only after Roche geometry; donor masses vary with WD/evolution models. Gaia d=160.257 pc replaces old prior-sensitive 163(+66/−50) or 113(+19/−16) pc branches; high-state spectroscopy identifies irradiated donor but not dynamical mass.
issues.why_it_matters: Post-minimum/period-bouncer and brown-dwarf-like labels affect population comparisons but remain model dependent; audit does not assume one evolutionary sequence.
issues.needed_action: Compare revised Gaia-distance low-state SED/templates with irradiated-line constraints and donor tracks; decide whether outward-facing class should remain proposed post-minimum/brown-dwarf-like or unresolved pending synthesis.

issues.competing_evidence: Howell+06 photospheric Zeeman 13.8±1 MG; Beuermann+07 tomography has probable 12–13 MG and broad surface maps plus 44 MG offset-dipole parameter; optical/IR cyclotron ~10–21/~13 MG; Szkody+10 local UV ~100 MG alternative; Barrett+20 radio 3210±365 G conditional on fundamental frequency.
issues.why_it_matters: These diagnostics measure different components and topology; one scalar WD field would mislead comparison.
issues.needed_action: Retain component-specific values; verify that the 44 MG value is labeled as a dipole-model parameter and the 100 MG value as a local UV fit alternative before exposing any single scalar.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 3 gives 3.7e−14 erg cm−2 s−1 (1–10 keV) with no source-specific uncertainty and cites Schwope+07. Full Schwope+07 reports 6e−14 in 0.1–10 keV for XMM E501, but no 1–10 value was located.
issues.why_it_matters: Band conversion, absorption convention and spectral assumptions affect radio/X-ray comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Locate the Ridder+23 conversion/model note or original XMM integration. If unavailable, retain 3.7e−14 as compiled with uncertainty unspecified, distinct from the explicitly reported 0.1–10 flux.

issues.competing_evidence: Bailey+82 scanned p.806 prints P=0.05626586 d with ±8 beneath final displayed digit, interpreted as ±0.00000008 d; Khangale+25 uses (8). Howell+06 quotes (80), factor ten larger under standard parenthetical notation. Central period agrees.
issues.why_it_matters: Long-baseline phase propagation differs; a period derivative must not be inferred from conflicting formal errors.
issues.needed_action: Confirm whether Howell+06 (80) is a typographical/transcription error from timing data or correction. Preserve Bailey/Khangale and Howell quotes separately until resolved.

references.note: ArXiv v2 retrieved and text-extracted locally. Broadband VLA follow-up including V2400 Oph: X band 8-12 GHz detections 266 +/-8 uJy on 2019 Apr 25 and 320 +/-8 uJy on 2019 May 11 with Stokes V non-detections; S band 2-4 GHz detections 519 +/-15 uJy on 2025 Aug 9 with no Stokes V and 637 +/-15 uJy on 2025 Aug 15 with 247 +/-7 uJy Stokes V, 39 +/-1 percent RCP.
